messages:
anna_m: Quick update — ran a fast-pass of weight-only INT8 (bitsandbytes + llm.int8) on llama-2-13b for the low-latency profile. Posting numbers + notes.

anna_m: Eval setup:
```
python tools/eval.py --model llama-2-13b --quant weight-only-int8 --backend bitsandbytes \
  --batch 8 --seq 2048 --temp 0.2 --prompts tests/regen_set.json
```

anna_m: Perf summary: fp16 baseline (dedicated dev pool): 2.2k tok/s, ~32GB GPU mem. INT8 weight-only: 2.6k tok/s (+18%), peak GPU mem down ~30%, KV cache unchanged.

miguel: Nice. What about quality?

anna_m: Quality: aggregated eval (instr-follow + few-shot QA):
- Exact match / acc: fp16 78.9% -> int8 78.1% (delta -0.8%)
- Rouge-L (summaries): -0.9 abs
- Perplexity on heldout: +1.7% (worse)
Edge cases: long-chain reasoning prompts show higher variance; generation truncation at long seqs in ~0.6% of runs (early EOS).

kai: Any examples of bad failures?

anna_m: Pasted two short diffs:
```
FP16: "The algorithm converges after ~15 iterations, and the error term decreases quadratically..."
INT8: "It converges in 15 iterations."  # loses the qualifier and a sentence in ~1/100 outputs
```

eva: That sounds small. Is it within our SLO for quality? Suggest canary 5% traffic.

miguel: Agree. Also let's watch hallucination metric (QA F1) and regen rate. If acc drop >1% or hallucination +2 pts, fallback.

anna_m: Perf-by-route: for short-chat (<=128 tokens) p50 latency improved ~12ms; for long-form (>=1024) end-to-end latency roughly same since KV/cache is not quantized.

ci-bot: perf-tests: /results/1772123456 showed latency/throughput tests passed; no regressions flagged.

kai: Next steps: try AWQ/GPTQ for better accuracy/size tradeoffs and run a layer-wise tuning for critical heads. Also try llm.int8 with per-channel scales (per-channel quant).

eva: I'll open a PR for a 5% canary and alert thresholds. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321

anna_m: Will run a 24h canary on staging with the regen set, push logs to s3://redwood-int8-evals/1772123456, and add monitoring dashboards (regen rate, QA F1, p50/p95 latencies).

miguel: SGTM. Add a test to catch long-seq EOS truncation in CI (leak test).

anna_m: noted. tagging @eng-platform for rollout config when PR is ready :thumbsup:

anna_m: If anyone wants raw eval artifacts / example counterfactuals I can drop CSV/JSON in the s3 path today.
